events.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Ipswich Town 1, Sunderland 0. Emersonn (Ipswich Town) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Julio Enciso following a fast break.
Dan Ballard (Sunderland) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Ipswich Town 1, Sunderland 1. Nilson Angulo (Sunderland) from a free kick with a right footed shot to the top left corner.
Second Half begins Ipswich Town 1, Sunderland 1.
Nilson Angulo (Sunderland) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Sunderland. Chemsdine Talbi replaces Nilson Angulo.
Luke O'Nien (Sunderland) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Ipswich Town. Kasey McAteer replaces Abdul Fatawu.
Substitution, Ipswich Town. Chuba Akpom replaces Emersonn.
Substitution, Sunderland. Omar Alderete replaces Luke O'Nien.
Substitution, Sunderland. Wilson Isidor replaces Brian Brobbey.
Delay in match because of an injury Julio Enciso (Ipswich Town).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Ipswich Town. Jack Clarke replaces Julio Enciso because of an injury.
Substitution, Sunderland. Chris Rigg replaces Trai Hume.
Substitution, Sunderland. Habib Diarra replaces Enzo Le Fée.
Substitution, Ipswich Town. Abdoul Ouattara replaces Daizen Maeda.
Substitution, Ipswich Town. Sindre Egeli replaces Marcelino Núñez.
Goal! Ipswich Town 2, Sunderland 1. Jack Clarke (Ipswich Town) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Sasa Lukic.
Second Half ends, Ipswich Town 2, Sunderland 1.
